card.name: Inside numbers before a unit
card.fires_on: Digits, hyphens or small joining words inside a number or measurement, right before a unit word such as week, gram, minute, mile, ounce or mg is expected.

modes.label: Last digit of a number
modes.description: A digit that completes a multi-digit number or range, with a unit coming next.

modes.label: Hyphen or compound before unit
modes.description: A hyphen or word like square linking a number to its unit, as in 4-gram or 54,000-square-foot.

modes.label: Joining word in a quantity
modes.description: A word like more inside a time or amount phrase, before the unit.
modes.example: allow an additional 2 or<< more>> minutes

card.writes: It promotes unit words such as grams, months, kilometers and hours, so it prepares a measurement unit after the number.
card.plain: It fires in the middle of a number or measurement when a unit like weeks, grams or minutes is about to come next.
